channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: “Couldn’t recover 100% from cramps”: Lakshya Sen after All England final defeat
item.description: The wait for another men’s singles champion at the All England continues, with the last triumph coming 25 years ago when Pullela Gopichand lifted the title in 2001.

item.title: Shivam Lohakare wins Javelin gold at Indian Open Throws
item.description: Army athlete throws 81.08m to top men’s javelin event as Kishore Kumar Jena returns with bronze.

item.title: India Women beat Uruguay 4-0 to start Hockey World Cup Qualifiers 2026 campaign
item.description: Goals from Sunelita Toppo, Ishika, Lalremsiami and Rutuja Pisal power India to a commanding win in Hyderabad opener.

item.title: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs to win record third T20 World Cup title
item.description: Samson’s 89 and Bumrah’s four-wicket spell power India to dominant victory after posting record 255 in the final.

item.title: I was body shamed for not fitting the image of an Indian woman | By Krishna Jayasankar
item.description: Krishna Jayasankar gets candid about her journey from shot put to discus, life in the NCAA system, qualifying for the NCAA Championships, and her dream of representing India on the global stage.

item.title: Radhamani Longjam and Sahil Duhan win on day 2 of World Boxing Futures Cup 2026
item.description: Indian youth boxers secure two victories in Bangkok as Radhamani and Sahil advance in their respective categories.

item.title: FIH Women's World Cup Qualifiers: India share spoils with Scotland - Highlights
item.description: India take on Scotland in their second Pool B match at the FIH Hockey World Cup Qualifiers 2026.

item.title: World Para Athletics GP 2026: India to field its largest contingent
item.description: Over 250 athletes from eight nations to compete across multiple track-and-field events.

item.title: Former India Volleyball Captain Abhijit Bhattacharya wins Global IOC Gender Equality award
item.description: Grassroots initiatives in Assam promoting equal sports participation for girls and boys earn Bhattacharya the IOC GEDI Champions global honour.

item.title: Scotland holds India 2-2 in FIH Women's Hockey World Cup Qualifiers
item.description: Goals from Navneet Kaur and Sunelita Toppo secure draw as India retain group lead on goal difference.
